recurrenceRecordedAsGuardrailFailure.detail: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: promotion_simulation.py wrote the internal mirror report by hand instead of running m0_mirror_audit.py, so the rehearsal reached a milestone status while the real control refused every delivery that corrects no audit (CP11-F-001).

GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: successor_durability.py covers the succession of checkpoints inside one Gate and not the transition into the next Gate, so the first delivery of any later Gate still could not reach READY_FOR_REVIEW (CP11-F-001).
